scenario: H0 sensitivity: two-lane SR-85 connector geometry hypothesis

additional_ramp_mappings.name: Shoreline Boulevard diagonal: SR-85 to NB US-101 candidate

additional_assumptions: Station 402920 inventory reports two 12-foot lanes, while the OSM-derived SUMO connector has one lane.

This sensitivity adds a second connector lane, connects feeder lanes 3 and 4 to connector lanes 1 and 0, and joins connector lanes 0 and 1 to US-101 lanes 4 and 5. Those lane-to-lane connections are geometry hypotheses, not verified PeMS detector-lane assignments.
Compare against the one-lane SR-85 candidate with matching demand dates and random seeds; this isolates network geometry, not a controller effect.
